layout: split
name: spiked corridor
mana cost: {3}{R}
types: enchantment room
triggered: when you unlock this door, create three 1/1 red devil creature tokens with "when this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."

ALTERNATE

name: torture pit
mana cost: {3}{R}
types: enchantment room
replacement: if a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
